reasons.plausibility: The role of short-range ordering in altering dislocation dynamics and mechanical properties is scientifically credible for multi-principal element alloys.
reasons.testability: Measuring hardness, strength, ductility, and directly quantifying short-range order in two well-controlled heat-treatment conditions provides a clear path to falsification.
reasons.usefulness: Identifying and confirming the effect of short-range ordering on mechanical properties is of significant practical value for tailoring high-entropy alloys.
